name: Gyan Developers & Builders Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1992, Gyan Developers & Builders Ltd is in the business of buying 
and selling vacant land.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
GDBL is a Chennai-based real estate developer that mainly dealing in the sale of vacant plots, in the outskirts of Chennai and its suburbs. It has promoted several residential flats in prime locations in the city of Madras, like Kodambakkam, Thiruvanmiyur and Kilpauk, etc. The company's business is dependent on:
a) Land development costs
b) Service charges
c) Sale of Land

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 8.09% over last 3 years.
